doc.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Blindfold record and Randy Sandke
summary: Rowe plays a record from a Gus Johnson tribute with Sandke, Hedges, Fay and Barrett.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well let me play a little snatch of a tune here, and see if you can — one of the many records you’ve played on.
You have any idea? Too many records?
Well it was a great sax sound and trumpet. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
Oh, who were all those guys? Who are they?
Yeah, that was a thing for Gus Johnson, for Gus Johnson.
Ralph, Chuck Hedges, Jake Hanna, Rick Fay, Dan Barrett.
Dan Barrett, yeah, yeah. I know the trombones, the trumpet was something I don’t — Randy — and he’s playing even better now, you know that? Playing even better now.
